fleetMemory.LESSON: A typecheck catches a class of defect that a green test suite cannot: a named import that is never exported arrives as `undefined`, and a defensive reader that treats `undefined` as 'nothing to read' turns the missing symbol into SILENTLY ABSENT DATA rather than an error. This lane's drawn-envelope path read no adoption date at all while 96 tests passed. If a new optional argument is threaded through a defensive reader, assert the CONSEQUENCE (the sentence contains the date), not the call.

'Is this a date?' and 'has this date arrived?' are different questions, and a shape-only date reader answers only the first. Comparing a shape-only value lexically to `asOf` promotes `2026-13-99` into a customer-facing legal fact. Any code that promotes a date to a customer-visible state must first require a real calendar date.

The predicate-debt gate makes an OPS-24 row's close citable-but-UNMEASURED rather than uncitable. The honest close cites the real instrument run and states that its `results` array is empty and why, instead of substituting a store-reading instrument (A-183) or a green suite for the customer predicate.
